digo_source: Mgombato ('kunde cowpea'; 'mtsafwe cowpea leaves eaten as a vegetable'); Pakia ('Kunde')

teaser.en: On the coast the cowpea is eaten twice: first its tender leaves as *mtsafwe*, then its black-eyed beans cooked in coconut milk.
teaser.sw: Pwani kunde huliwa mara mbili: kwanza majani yake machanga kama *mtsafwe*, kisha punje zake zenye 'jicho' jeusi zikipikwa kwa tui la nazi.
teaser.dg: Pwani, kunde nkuriwa mara mbiri: kpwandza makodzage malaini dza *mtsafwe*, chisha tembeze zenye alama nyiru, zichijitwa na huwi.

summary.en: *Kunde* is the cowpea or black-eyed bean, grown among maize and cassava on Digo farms. Both its seeds and its young leaves, *mtsafwe*, are favourite foods.
summary.sw: *Kunde* ni mmea wa kunde, unaopandwa katikati ya mahindi na mihogo kwenye mashamba ya Wadigo. Mbegu zake na majani yake machanga, *mtsafwe*, ni vyakula vinavyopendwa sana.
summary.dg: *Kunde* ni mmea unaoihwa *cowpea* au *black-eyed bean* kpwa Chingereza, unaophandwa kahi ya matsere na manga kpwenye minda ya Adigo. Tembeze na makodzage malaini, *mtsafwe*, ni vyakurya vinavyomendzwa sana.

about.en:
*Kunde* is a bean plant that grows either as a low bush or as a climber, depending on the variety. Its leaves have three leaflets, and its flowers are pale purple or white. The pods are long and slender, holding a row of kidney-shaped seeds, often cream with a dark 'eye' where the seed was attached.

Digo farmers grow several named cultivars, including *chifumbatele*, *koroboi*, *zonga* and *chimakoko*.
about.sw:
*Kunde* ni mmea wa jamii ya maharagwe unaokua kama kichaka kifupi au kama mtambaa, kutegemea aina yake. Kila jani lina vijani vitatu, na maua yake ni ya zambarau hafifu au meupe. Maganda yake ni marefu na membamba, na ndani yana safu ya mbegu zenye umbo la figo, mara nyingi za rangi ya krimu zenye 'jicho' jeusi mahali mbegu ilipokuwa imeshikamana.

Wakulima wa Kidigo hupanda aina kadhaa zenye majina yake, zikiwemo *chifumbatele*, *koroboi*, *zonga* na *chimakoko*.
about.dg:
*Kunde* ni mmea wa jamii ya kunde. Aina zanjina zinamera photsi dza mihi midide, na zanjina zinakpwera. Makodzage ganamera mahahu-mahahu, na maruwage ni ga rangi ya zambarau ngushu-ngushu au ga rangi nyereru. Makakaya ni mare na membamba, na ndani kuna mstari wa tembe za umbo ra figo, mara nyinji za rangi ya maziya, zenye 'dzitso' ra rangi nyiru phatu tembe ririphokala rinagbwirana na kakaya.

Akurima a Adigo anaphanda aina nyinji zenye madzina, phamwenga na *chifumbatele*, *koroboi*, *zonga* na *chimakoko*.

where.en: *Kunde* is a farm crop, usually intercropped with maize and cassava in the same field. Look for it on family farms across Kwale during the rains, scrambling between the maize stalks.
where.sw: *Kunde* ni zao la shambani, kwa kawaida hupandwa pamoja na mahindi na mihogo katika shamba moja. Wakati wa mvua utaiona kwenye mashamba ya familia kote Kwale, ikitambaa katikati ya mabua ya mahindi.
where.dg: *Kunde* ni mmea wa mndani; mara nyinji inaphandwa phamwenga na matsere na manga kpwenye munda mmwenga. Wakati wa mvula, unaweza kuiona kpwenye minda ya mbari kosi Kwale, ichikpwera kahi ya mihi ya matsere.

uses.en:
The dried seeds are cooked either plain or with coconut milk, a common coastal dish. Before cooking, they are sometimes ground to remove the skins, a job with its own Digo verb, *paza*.

The young leaves, called *mtsafwe*, are one of the favourite greens. They are picked while the plants are growing and cooked as a vegetable, so the crop feeds the family long before the beans are ready.
uses.sw:
Mbegu zilizokaushwa hupikwa bila kitu au kwa tui la nazi, mlo wa kawaida wa pwani. Kabla ya kupikwa, wakati mwingine husagwa ili kuondoa maganda, kazi yenye kitenzi chake cha Kidigo, *paza*.

Majani machanga, yanayoitwa *mtsafwe*, ni mojawapo ya mboga za majani zinazopendwa zaidi. Huchumwa mimea ikiwa bado inakua na kupikwa kama mboga, hivyo zao hili hulisha familia muda mrefu kabla kunde zenyewe hazijakomaa.
uses.dg:
Tembe zikauma nkujitwa bila huwi au na huwi, chakurya cha kawaida cha pwani. Kabla ya kujitwa, wakati wanjina nkusagbwa kuusa magada, kazi yenye neno rakpwe ra Chidigo, *paza*.

Makodza malaini, ganayoihwa *mtsafwe*, ni kahi ya mboga zinazomendzwa sana. Nkudolwa mimea ichikala bado inakula na nkujitwa dza mboga, kpwa hivyo mmea uhu unarisa mbari muda mure kabla ya tembe kukala tayari.

names.en: Digo: *kunde* for the plant and the beans, and *mtsafwe* for the leaves eaten as a vegetable. Swahili: *kunde*, with the leaves called *majani ya kunde*. English: cowpea or black-eyed bean. Scientists call it *Vigna unguiculata*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *kunde* kwa mmea na kwa punje zake, na *mtsafwe* kwa majani yanayoliwa kama mboga. Kiswahili: *kunde*, na majani huitwa *majani ya kunde*. Kwa Kiingereza: *cowpea* au *black-eyed bean*. Wanasayansi huuita *Vigna unguiculata*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo: *kunde* kpwa mmea na kpwa tembe, na *mtsafwe* kpwa makodza ganayoriwa dza mboga. Kpwa Chiswahili: *kunde*, na makodza nkuihwa *majani ya kunde*. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *cowpea* au *black-eyed bean*. Kpwa chisayansi inaihwa *Vigna unguiculata*.
